data.name: Madiha
data.gender_notes: Madiha is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of madīḥ, from the Arabic root م-د-ح (m-d-ḥ), 'to praise'. Its root is م-د-ح (m-d-ḥ). A common Muslim female name. Madiha is a Arabic name meaning “Praiseworthy; commendable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Madiha expresses “Praiseworthy; commendable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of madīḥ, from the Arabic root م-د-ح (m-d-ḥ), 'to praise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madiha total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
